visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Jensen Huang, a male with silver hair wearing a black leather jacket and glasses, stands on a large stage. He holds a compact electronic device in his right hand and a black laptop in his left. Behind him is a massive screen displaying a high-resolution image of a classical European-style building with a reflective pool. (2) Jensen walks across the stage; the background screen transitions to show a 3D digital architectural office layout with various workstations and screens. He uses expressive hand gestures while presenting to the audience. Yellow and white subtitles appear centered at the bottom of the frame. (3) A wide shot from the back of the auditorium shows the massive stage screen displaying a digital stadium in a city setting near mountains. Many audience members are seen from behind, holding up smartphones to record the event. (4) The scene cuts to a digital map of Texas showing the "Stargate" data center. Jensen stands to the left of the screen, gesturing toward the aerial imagery. The lighting is bright and focused on the presenter. (5) Jensen stands next to a large, black industrial server rack filled with dense wiring and illuminated components. He points to the hardware as "A Thinking Machine" text is visible on the screen behind him. (6) A sequence of corporate logos including Foxconn, TSMC, and NVIDIA are shown on the stage screen against a black background. Jensen stands in the center, speaking. (7) The camera focuses on small hardware devices labeled "DGX Spark" and "DGX Station" resting on black pedestals. (8) Jensen is shown in a smaller inset screen during a behind-the-scenes moment, talking with a group of men in a brightly lit room. (9) The final scene takes place outdoors on a city sidewalk next to a green gear store truck decorated with NVIDIA t-shirts. A long queue of people in professional attire stands waiting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator begins speaking in Traditional Chinese with a fast tempo and bright, professional tone. The background music is an upbeat electronic pop track with a strong synth bass line and a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat at approximately 124 BPM. The recording is studio-clean with high fidelity. (2) Jensen Huang's voice is heard as he delivers a slogan in English with an authoritative and confident tone. A short, percussive synth stinger sound effect emphasizes the transition. The narrator continues explaining the context, and the BGM maintains its energetic pace. (3) A loud crowd cheering and applause sound effect is layered over the mix as Jensen announces a new location. The narrator's pitch rises slightly to match the excitement of the crowd noise. The music remains a consistent rhythmic bed underneath the speech. (4) Multiple short, sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effects occur as the narrator lists various corporate partners and AI infrastructure projects. The narrator's speech is dense, with very few pauses, creating an informative yet rapid pacing. (5) A synthesized notification sound and a camera shutter sound effect are audible during the mention of digital twins and mobile devices. The electronic music track becomes slightly more prominent in the mix during a brief vocal pause before the narrator concludes the segment with a final enthusiastic remark. The BGM then fades out quickly.
